title: Comparing two changes at the paper punch
titleZh: 比較打孔機的兩項調整
passage: Here are the five runs from our paper punch trial. We counted the scraps left on the worktop, not the ones that landed in the bin. Between runs one and two, we brushed out the gap around the bin. Between runs three and four, we added a paper guard along the edge. One lower bar isn’t enough. For a change to count, both of the next two runs have to be below the run just before that change. We used the same number of sheets for each run. If you repeat the trial, clear the worktop before each run so you don’t count scraps from the previous one.
passageZh: 這是打孔機試驗的五輪結果。我們算的是留在工作檯面上的紙屑，不是落入收集盒的紙屑。第一輪和第二輪之間，我們刷掉了收集盒周圍縫隙裡的紙屑。第三輪與第四輪之間，我們沿邊緣加了一道紙擋板。 只看到一根較低的長條還不夠。若要認定某項調整達到要求，接下來兩輪的數值都要低於該項調整前的最後一輪。 每輪使用的紙張數相同。如果你要重做試驗，每輪開始前先清理檯面，免得把前一輪留下的紙屑也算進去。
